claims.claim: Battery is new, holds charge for 8 hours. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show only a solar panel (front and back with connectors). No battery is shown, and no battery test/label is visible.

risks.risk: Panel wattage/rating is unknown (could be low output), which strongly affects resale value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the panel rating label/sticker showing Wp (e.g., 100W/200W/300W) and model number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic/unknown-output used solar panel at the worst-case low rating.

risks.risk: Condition may be compromised (micro-cracks, delamination, water ingress) even if the surface looks intact.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the glass surface and frame edges in good light (no glare), plus a clip showing the panel flex test is not possible—so instead show undamaged corners and no visible cracks; ideally a power test reading under sun.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible defects (treat as not guaranteed performance).

risks.risk: Connector/junction box details are unclear (type, cable length, and whether bypass diodes/junction box are intact).
risks.proof: A close photo of the junction box area and connectors (e.g., MC4) with cable length visible and any markings readable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as panel only with uncertain wiring/connectors; assume buyer may need replacement cables/connectors.

risks.risk: Frame condition (dents, rust/corrosion, loose mounting holes) can reduce usability and safety.
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides of the frame and mounting holes/edges, taken from multiple angles showing any dents/rust.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible frame wear; assume mounting hardware may be missing or unreliable.

risks.risk: Brand is visible but exact model is not; mismatch between brand/model and actual specs can affect value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full branding/model plate on the back (readable text).
risks.if_unproven: Price based on worst-case generic used panel value for the visible form factor.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the panel rating label (Wp, voltage/current, and model number).
Send close-up photos of the junction box and connectors (show connector type and cable condition/length).
Send photos of the frame/mounting holes from all sides showing any dents/rust/corrosion.
If a battery is included, send photos of the battery label/specs and a video showing it charging/holding charge (8 hours) with a meter reading.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a solar panel, but key pricing drivers (wattage/rating and condition details) are not readable in the provided shots. Without the rating label and clearer condition/junction details, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
